_meta.purpose: Runnable primitive case adapted from OpenSRE's http-abort experiment. Simplest end-to-end runnable case — verifies the case_runner + AlertManager + incident-tracker chain works. Reproduces via a 100% error_rate fault on checkout /checkout for the duration of load.

title: [Triggered] checkout 5xx rate above 5%
message: 5xx rate for checkout has been > 5% for 1 minute.
text: checkout /checkout endpoint returning HTTP 500 to all callers.
